WITH U AS( SELECT DENSE_RANK() OVER(ORDER BY T.ITEM_NO) RNUM , T.* FROM ( SELECT M.ITEM_NO, ITEM_NM, SALE_PRICE, SAFETY_AMOUNT, ITEM_DEL , SUM(CASE WHEN REMAIN_AMOUNT > 0 THEN REMAIN_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) REMAIN_AMOUNT , MIN(CASE WHEN RECORD_TY = 1 AND EXP_DATE > SYSDATE AND REMAIN_AMOUNT > 0 THEN EXP_DATE ELSE NULL END ) EXP_DATE , ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN RECORD_TY = 1 THEN RECORD_ITEM_PRICE END),2) AS AVG_PURCHASE_PRICE FROM ITEM M LEFT OUTER JOIN INVNTRY_RECORD R ON M.ITEM_NO = R.ITEM_NO GROUP BY M.ITEM_NO, ITEM_NM, SALE_PRICE, SAFETY_AMOUNT, ITEM_DEL ) T
) SELECT * FROM U WHERE U.RNUM BETWEEN (#{currentPage} * 10) - (10-1) AND (#{currentPage} * 10)

WITH U AS( SELECT DENSE_RANK() OVER(ORDER BY T.EXP_DATE DESC) RNUM , T.* FROM ( SELECT D.ITEM_NO, ITEM_NM, USER_NO, SALE_PRICE, RECORD_AMOUNT, REMAIN_AMOUNT , EXP_DATE, D.HEAD_ORDER_NO, RECORD_ITEM_PRICE, RECORD_REG_DATE FROM INVNTRY_RECORD D JOIN ITEM M ON D.ITEM_NO = M.ITEM_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN HEAD_ORDER H ON D.HEAD_ORDER_NO = H.HEAD_ORDER_NO WHERE RECORD_TY = 1 AND M.ITEM_NO = #{itemNo} ) T ) SELECT * FROM U WHERE U.RNUM BETWEEN (#{currentPage} * 10) - (10-1) AND (#{currentPage} * 10)

WITH U AS( SELECT DENSE_RANK() OVER(ORDER BY T.STORE_ORDER_NO) RNUM , T.* FROM ( SELECT M.ITEM_NO, ITEM_NM, SALE_PRICE, ITEM_DEL, EXP_DATE, R.STORE_ORDER_NO, STORE_NM, RECORD_REG_DATE, RECORD_AMOUNT FROM ITEM M LEFT OUTER JOIN INVNTRY_RECORD R ON M.ITEM_NO = R.ITEM_NO JOIN STORE_ORDER SO ON R.STORE_ORDER_NO = SO.STORE_ORDER_NO JOIN STORE S ON SO.STORE_NO = S.STORE_NO WHERE RECORD_TY= 2 AND M.ITEM_NO = #{itemNo} ) T ) SELECT * FROM U WHERE U.RNUM BETWEEN (#{currentPage} * 10) - (10-1) AND (#{currentPage} * 10)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT M.ITEM_NO, ITEM_NM, SALE_PRICE, SAFETY_AMOUNT, ITEM_DEL , SUM(CASE WHEN REMAIN_AMOUNT > 0 THEN REMAIN_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) REMAIN_AMOUNT , MIN(CASE WHEN RECORD_TY = 1 AND EXP_DATE > SYSDATE AND REMAIN_AMOUNT > 0 THEN EXP_DATE ELSE NULL END ) EXP_DATE , ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN RECORD_TY = 1 THEN RECORD_ITEM_PRICE END),2) AS AVG_PURCHASE_PRICE FROM ITEM M LEFT OUTER JOIN INVNTRY_RECORD R ON M.ITEM_NO = R.ITEM_NO GROUP BY M.ITEM_NO, ITEM_NM, SALE_PRICE, SAFETY_AMOUNT, ITEM_DEL ) T

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT D.ITEM_NO, ITEM_NM, USER_NO, SALE_PRICE, RECORD_AMOUNT, REMAIN_AMOUNT , EXP_DATE, D.HEAD_ORDER_NO, RECORD_ITEM_PRICE, RECORD_REG_DATE FROM INVNTRY_RECORD D JOIN ITEM M ON D.ITEM_NO = M.ITEM_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN HEAD_ORDER H ON D.HEAD_ORDER_NO = H.HEAD_ORDER_NO WHERE RECORD_TY = 1 AND M.ITEM_NO = #{itemNo} ) T

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT M.ITEM_NO, ITEM_NM, SALE_PRICE, ITEM_DEL, EXP_DATE, R.STORE_ORDER_NO, STORE_NM, RECORD_REG_DATE, RECORD_AMOUNT FROM ITEM M LEFT OUTER JOIN INVNTRY_RECORD R ON M.ITEM_NO = R.ITEM_NO JOIN STORE_ORDER SO ON R.STORE_ORDER_NO = SO.STORE_ORDER_NO JOIN STORE S ON SO.STORE_NO = S.STORE_NO WHERE RECORD_TY= 2 AND M.ITEM_NO = #{itemNo} ) T
